  WHY: clamping `--top-k` to 20 limits recall when a larger retrieval budget would be needed.

  WHY: fields containing spaces are rendered with quotes, so log consumers expecting simple tokenization can misparse them.

  WHY: quoted or spaced values are not emitted uniformly, so telemetry extraction can misparse fields.

  PROBLEM: The removed test no longer checks that the unresolved-placeholder guard fires for `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`.
  WHY: placeholder injection/removal cases are covered, but the explicit guard path is not behaviorally tested.
